issues.problem: The Atlas spine still runs directly from the player Exile and Zana defeating the Elder to the Conquerors' madness. The Conquerors arc uses the alternate Elderslayers history in which Zana recruited Sirus and companions instead of the player Exile; the edge fuses incompatible versions after the first-round curation.
issues.fix: Detach event_atlas_conquerors from the Shaper/Elder player spine; make the Elderslayers history its background prerequisite and start the player's Conquerors quest chain from Kirac without asserting a direct Elder-victory sequence.
issues.evidence: data/raw/poewiki/History_of_Wraeclast.wiki:783 describes the player Exile and Zana expelling the Elder; lines 787-801 explicitly say Conquerors instead had Zana recruit the Elderslayers, whose later madness and Sirus's sacrifice belong to that version.

issues.problem: The Atlas next_beat chain makes the Searing Exarch quest precede the Eater of Worlds quest, and makes the Maven quest a predecessor of both. The three are optional parallel endgame quests and can be undertaken in different orders.

issues.evidence: data/raw/poewiki/The_Searing_Exarch_quest_.wiki:6,13-16: required=no, explicitly parallel to Maven and Eater, with an Eater-first case; data/raw/poewiki/The_Eater_of_Worlds_quest_.wiki:6,13: required=no and explicitly parallel.
